description.value: A boat-in lakeside camp on Alouette Lake within Golden Ears Park's rugged backcountry, offering 16 sites in coastal hemlock forest with pit toilets; reachable only by paddle craft, so inaccessible to touring cyclists but a genuine wilderness retreat.
